seo.title: Speaking
seo.description: Book Dr. Len Tau, The Reviews Doctor, for your study club, dental meeting or conference. Lively talks on reviews, reputation and online visibility.

intro.title: Lively talks. | Strategies you can | use on Monday.
paragraphs: I speak to dentists and their teams about reviews, reputation and online visibility. Every talk is packed with steps you can put to work right away.
I travel the country for study clubs, dental meetings and national conferences. My courses change often, because the way patients search keeps changing. Ask me for the latest course list.

quote.text: When it comes to 21st century dental practice marketing, Dr. Len Tau is fast becoming the industry standard. Dr. Len Tau is a fun, engaging lecturer who is happy to take questions and welcomes immediate feedback.
quote.name: Arun K. Garg, DMD

nocost.title: Bring me to your group | at no cost.

topics.title: What I speak | about now.
topics.intro: Each talk can run as a keynote, a lecture or a hands-on workshop.

items.title: Be Seen, Be Trusted, Be Chosen
items.text: Patients pick a dentist before they call. They compare reviews, listings, and visibility, not clinical skill. This talk walks through the full system I used to build a 4.9-star practice.
objectives: Find out how patients compare practices online
Fix the listings that cost you calls you never see
Build a review system that runs every day without reminders

items.title: Get Found by Patients and AI
items.text: Patients now ask AI tools which dentist to see. Those tools lean on the same signals Google uses: reviews, listings, and steady content. Learn what changed and what to do Monday.
objectives: See how AI tools choose which practices to recommend
Run a simple AI visibility check on your own practice
Learn which signals matter most in local search now
Get a checklist for your website and Google profile

items.title: OMG! Bad Review! What to Do?!
items.text: The best practice is not the one with perfect reviews. It is the one with a plan. Learn how to answer criticism, protect your profile, and remove reviews that break Google's rules.
objectives: Respond to negative reviews in a calm, professional voice
Know which reviews Google will remove and how to report them
Bury one bad review under steady five-star reviews
Avoid the replies that make things worse

items.title: Your Team Runs the System
items.text: The review ask cannot depend on someone remembering. This hands-on workshop gives your team the words, the timing, and the ownership.
objectives: Assign clear ownership for reviews and responses
Turn your front desk into your best marketers
